title: Authority map: Workbench coordinates but does not absorb its dependencies
summary: The Workbench is an orchestrator over existing authorities. Source state belongs to Semantic Source Store/Development Desk; interpretation and commit policy belong to Intention Service; language operation spelling/contracts belong to Coding Intention; outbound HTTP/TLS belongs to API Client; compile/runtime truth belongs to the selected ooRexx/toolchain environment.
invariants: Do not fork or silently rewrite Coding Intention from the Workbench lane.
Do not make API transport own coding semantics.
Do not let model output replace controller-owned source identity or actor fields.
Do not infer source success from a model report; use authoritative verification evidence.
Local SSCS access remains available without a website or HTTPS server.

provenance.claim: Coding lane, dependency ownership and website-free local SSCS chain.
Source, Intention and API Client authority boundaries are explicit in Workbench source.
